capabilities: Draw pressure-sensitive ink with pen, highlighter and eraser
Insert shapes and select, move, scale, rotate or split strokes with a lasso
Manage pages with thumbnails, sections, titles and page styles
Import PDFs as page backgrounds and paste or crop images
Export notes to PDF and keep automatic version history
extras: Notes are stored as .hnote files with a hidden data folder rather than Markdown; a bundled Python script (hnote2pdf.py) converts notes to PDF without Obsidian. The author states the plugin is entirely vibe-coded with Claude Code and warns of bugs and rough edges.
motivation: The author wanted handwritten notes alongside regular Markdown notes and was frustrated with the existing tools.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown notes cannot hold freehand ink, so handwritten pages and sketches have to live in a separate app.
summary: Notebook-style handwriting editor with pressure ink, shapes, lasso selection, page management, PDF import and PDF export.
